title: Products for the condensed-coefficient extension by zero.
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring, X a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, and j:U→X a quasi-compact open immersion. The unbounded derived category of modules over the pulled-back ring Λ_U has all products indexed by Type(u+1). The termwise derived condensed-coefficient extension by zero D(j_!) preserves products of every such shape, including the empty product.

source.place: proof (1), sums, products, and arbitrary limits

proof.text: Internal modules are Grothendieck abelian and admit K-injective resolutions. The existing DerivedCategory.hasLimitsOfShape_discrete instance gives products, including the empty product. Take the reduced closed complement using vanishingIdeal and its subscheme immersion. Apply proEtale_openExtension_products_derivedLimits to B=condensedRingObj Λ X. Its standard-universe derived linear extension preserves products. Compare the two choices of localization by Localization.uniq; their factorization natural isomorphisms descend by liftNatIso and transfer product preservation. Restriction along the invertible condensedPullbackHom is an exact equivalence. Derive its inverse adjunction to see that its derived functor is a right adjoint and preserves products. The composition comparison mapDerivedCategoryCompIso identifies the composite with the condensed open extension.

theorem condensedOpenExtensionProducts
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] :
    HasProducts.{u + 1} (DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ U))) ∧
    (∀ I : Type (u + 1), PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
      (openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory)
